remarks: Few architects' work is recognizable from a single silhouette. Iconic midcentury modern architect William Pereira is one of them- he designed the Transamerica Pyramid in San Francisco and the Theme Building at LAX. This building is his as well, and one of the rarer examples still standing close to how he designed it and one of the very few iconic midcentury modern structures in Santa Barbara. Set on 3.5 acres atop the apex of TV Hill, the property has sweeping ocean and mountain views. Few properties in the area offer this kind of vantage point, let alone paired with architecture of this caliber. The zoning is what really sets it apart.
